context: The brief is now self-contained. Under Architecture it inlines: the RS-FIX-1 fixture with pinned inventory (1 bundle per supplier A-E); the planner rules (lexicographic objective, multiplicity bound, candidate codes, per-candidate codes, computed relaxations); four state machines with authorization_pending, capture_pending and refund_pending; a 13-row precedence table deriving the rescue status (including cancelling, refunding and failed_needs_attention); and the payment saga (exclusive approved->executing claim under BEGIN IMMEDIATE, reservation consumed in the same transaction, void rule for RS-13/15/17/18/21, point where supersession stops applying, restart and lease takeover). It also adds the PayPal return/session design (token-owner check, idempotent authorize, SameSite=Lax, fake approval page on a different site), idempotency rules, a data model and API summary, runtime model budget and rate limit, the degraded manual-entry path, the eval corpus test/fixtures/extraction/ EXT-1, and template-rendered explanations. Orchestrator decisions cited: dec-mv16pyxx-01bad0bf (Node >= 22.13), dec-mv16pz0g-01d5c4c2 (Q1/Q3/Q4/Q6/Q8 defaults), dec-mv16pz32-013c4cd1 (test script layout). All 45 criterion ids are kept; ACs were strengthened as the findings required. The only narrowing of a user requirement is the Node floor in NFR1 (RS-NF-1 says >= 22.5; the orchestrator decision says >= 22.13), which is flagged as Q9 for the user, and the NFR1 AC states the pass condition under either answer. The 'Where this brief goes beyond goal.md' subsection lists every extension. goal.md is unchanged. Provenance: the revision was written by an earlier product-architect context that could not place it because of the nested-root guard defect (preserved unchanged at docs/evidence/verification-0.3.0/pilot-blocked-nested-root/brief-r2.md, sha256 8f5d938c...). This context re-checked it against the review findings, goal.md and the recorded decisions, and placed it with three corrections, listed as the '(placement)' rows of the response table: (1) the admin stock-depletion fault now withdraws the offer and lets supersession cancel unconfirmed orders, so RS-32's old plan ends 'superseded' as its AC requires (previously the fault refused orders, which yields non_executable); (2) an operation in 'approved' with an authorize call still intent/unknown is voided at the provider after reconciliation instead of locally, so no authorization is orphaned; (3) the NFR1 AC states the Q9 'keep 22.5' alternative. Risks RISK-13..RISK-18 are in the register (RISK-15 mitigated). eccode memory search returned no records, so no lessons were cited.
